parole.testo: From American English cafeteria, from Latin American Spanish cafetería.

parole.significato: voodoo; a Haitian and Caribbean religion combining elements of West African religions with Catholicism
parole.testo: Borrowed from American English voodoo, from Louisiana Creole voudou, from Haitian Creole Vodou, ultimately from a West African language, perhaps Ewe vódũ (“deity, idol”), Fon vòdún (“fetish”), or Kwa vodũ. First attested before 1971. Compare Norwegian Nynorsk voodoo, Danish voodoo, Swedish voodoo, F
